# D2Client -- patch carrier, NOT a reimplementation module.
#
# Unlike D2Common/D2Game/etc (which reimplement the real DLL's exported
# ordinals one-for-one), D2Client has no reimplementation source at all yet.
# This target exists solely to host the shadow-dispatch conformance machinery
# (D2Client_ShadowDispatch.gen.h, generated by
# conformance/tools/gen_shadow_dispatch.py from
# conformance/shadow_manifest.D2Client.json) via D2Client.patch.cpp, which
# D2MOO_register_D2_DLL_patches() attaches automatically -- "D2Client" is
# already in D2_KNOWN_DLLS (cmake/D2MOO.ModHelpers.cmake).
#
# It is loaded ALONGSIDE the real D2Client.dll as a patch (same model as
# D2Common.dll's patch carrier and D2Debugger.dll), never as a drop-in
# replacement -- see CONFORMANCE_TAXONOMY_V2.md's "provider DLL, not a
# drop-in binary (yet)" note.
add_library(D2Client SHARED
  src/D2Client.cpp
)
D2MOO_configure_exports(D2Client IGNORE_MISSING_DEF)
# Header-only (INTERFACE lib) -- D2_VERSION_113C / D2_MAYBE_UNUSED for
# D2Client.patch.cpp, matching every other patch module's convention.
target_link_libraries(D2Client PRIVATE D2CommonDefinitions)
